properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Storage Account: No Public Blob Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Storage Accounts with public blob access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Storage Accounts containing federal data must only be accessible via Private Endpoint — public blob access is prohibited to prevent unauthorized data exposure.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Storage Accounts with public blob access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
